uutiset.t: Anthropic Becomes World’s 7th Most Valuable Company After IPO
uutiset.s: Anthropic PBC’s blockbuster IPO lifted the company into the ranks of the most valuable in the world, with shares closing 17% from the offer price to give it a $1.8 trillion fully diluted market value.

uutiset.t: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Nov. 20
uutiset.s: Oil edged higher after a volatile session on Thursday, with futures on track for a third weekly decline as traders weigh the risk of renewed US strikes on Iran against signs of ample supply.

uutiset.t: Treasury Official Renews Warning on Wave of Tax-Saving Trades
uutiset.s: A senior US Treasury official reiterated concerns Thursday about Wall Street’s tax-efficient investing boom, saying firms should win clients on the merits of their investments, not on how far they’ll go to minimize a tax bill.

uutiset.t: Anthropic IPO is About Capital, Says Kathryn Thompson
uutiset.s: Anthropic’s long-awaited debut marks the first ever by a frontier AI lab, a cohort of firms building the most advanced models to tackle difficult problems and assist users in complex tasks. uutiset.t: Stock Losses to Extend in Asia, Nasdaq Futures Dip: Markets Wrap
uutiset.s: A global stock selloff was set to deepen in Asia as Anthropic PBC’s solid market debut failed to reverse pessimism around the artificial-intelligence trade and stem a broader retreat from technology shares.

uutiset.t: NY’s Largest Mall Debt Now Controlled by Billionaire Namdar
uutiset.s: The debt on Destiny USA, New York state’s largest shopping center, has been acquired by Namdar Realty Group, a Long Island-based real estate firm known for distressed retail real estate deals.

uutiset.t: Anthropic Jumps 17% in Record IPO as Broader Tech Market Sells Off | Closing Bell
uutiset.s: Comprehensive cross-platform coverage of the U.S. market close on Bloomberg Television, Bloomberg Radio, and YouTube with Romaine Bostick, Ed Ludlow, Carol Massar and Tim Stenovec. (Source: Bloomberg)

uutiset.t: Shenkman, Blackstone, GDA Among Lenders to Take Over Vivid
uutiset.s: A group of lenders including Blackstone Inc. and Shenkman Capital Management are set to take over Vivid Seats Inc. in a deal that would reduce the ticket reseller’s net debt by more than $200 million, according to people familiar with the matter.

uutiset.t: US Banks Send Bearish ‘Death Cross’ Signal as Stock Rout Extends
uutiset.s: After the worst four-day run since April 2025, shares of large US banks sank into a “death cross” technical pattern, flashing a bearish momentum signal for a sector plagued by business disruption concerns and the unraveling of the artificial intelligence trade.

uutiset.t: Google-Tied Muni Deals Delayed Due to Lackluster Demand
uutiset.s: Two prepaid energy deals totaling $3 billion, which featured Google parent company Alphabet Inc. as funding recipient, were delayed due to lackluster investor demand amid market volatility, according to a person familiar with the matter.

uutiset.t: Alphabet Raises $4.2 Billion From Latest Canada Bond Sale
uutiset.s: Alphabet Inc. sold C$6 billion ($4.2 billion) of Canadian bonds, six months after its market debut.

uutiset.t: AMD Falls on Hunterbrook Short Call That Cites China Risks
uutiset.s: Advanced Micro Devices Inc. shares slid after Hunterbrook Capital said it shorted the stock, following a report by its media affiliate that the chipmaker is reliant on a potentially risky business in China.

uutiset.t: Mexican Peso Rout Deepens as Banxico, Fed Policies Diverge
uutiset.s: The Mexican peso sank past the 19-per-dollar mark to its lowest in over a year, as the prospect of further Federal Reserve interest-rate hikes intensified a selloff triggered by Mexico’s dovish monetary policy.

uutiset.t: Anthropic Shares Jump 17% After $107.3 Billion IPO Breaks Record
uutiset.s: Anthropic PBC shares soared 17% above their IPO price in the biggest offering on record, raising $107.3 billion despite signs of growing caution around the artificial intelligence trade.

uutiset.t: Latin America Currencies Sink on Rate Worries; Brazil Intervenes
uutiset.s: A selloff in Latin American currencies extended to a second session on Thursday, sending the Mexican peso to its lowest since June 2025 and pushing Brazil’s central bank to step in to prop up the real, amid the mounting prospects for more rate hikes in the US.
